passages.text: A new member joins our board-game club halfway through the term. We want to be friendly to him, so we introduce ourselves and explain where the games are kept. At the first table, we choose a game whose rules can be explained in a few minutes. This gives everyone a chance to talk and get along with a new partner without a difficult start. Later, he teaches us a different game that he used to play with his cousins. By the end of the meeting, he is both a learner and someone with a useful idea for the club.

parallelText.en: A new member joins our board-game club halfway through the term.
parallelText.zh: 学期中途，一位新成员加入我们桌游社团。

parallelText.en: We want to be friendly to him, so we introduce ourselves and explain where the games are kept.
parallelText.zh: 我们想友好地对待他，于是作自我介绍并说明游戏放在哪里。

parallelText.en: At the first table, we choose a game whose rules can be explained in a few minutes.
parallelText.zh: 在第一张桌旁，我们选择一个几分钟就能说明规则的游戏。

parallelText.en: This gives everyone a chance to talk and get along with a new partner without a difficult start.
parallelText.zh: 这样每个人都有机会交流、与新搭档相处，而不会一开始就遇到困难。

parallelText.en: Later, he teaches us a different game that he used to play with his cousins.
parallelText.zh: 后来，他教我们另一种以前和表亲玩的游戏。

parallelText.en: By the end of the meeting, he is both a learner and someone with a useful idea for the club.
parallelText.zh: 聚会结束时，他既是一位学习者，也是一位能为社团提出实用想法的人。

wordHelp.meaning: a part of the school year

passages.text: Visitors at the school exhibition come from several nearby neighbourhoods. Our class puts a simple map near the entrance to help them find the rooms. One visitor pauses by my desk and says, “Excuse me, where is the room with the garden models?” I point to the room on the map and explain the route using two clear landmarks. She repeats the room number to check her understanding before walking away. Afterwards, I add a larger arrow to the map because several visitors asked the same question.

parallelText.en: Visitors at the school exhibition come from several nearby neighbourhoods.
parallelText.zh: 学校展览的参观者来自附近几个社区。

parallelText.en: Our class puts a simple map near the entrance to help them find the rooms.
parallelText.zh: 我们班在入口附近放了一张简易地图，帮助他们找到各房间。

parallelText.en: One visitor pauses by my desk and says, “Excuse me, where is the room with the garden models?”
parallelText.zh: 一位参观者在我的桌边停下，说：“劳驾，花园模型在哪个房间？”

parallelText.en: I point to the room on the map and explain the route using two clear landmarks.
parallelText.zh: 我指着地图上的房间，用两个清楚的标志物解释路线。

parallelText.en: She repeats the room number to check her understanding before walking away.
parallelText.zh: 她重复房间号，确认自己理解正确后才走开。

parallelText.en: Afterwards, I add a larger arrow to the map because several visitors asked the same question.
parallelText.zh: 随后，我在地图上加了一个更大的箭头，因为已有几位参观者问过同样的问题。
